title: Scaling Clinical Judgment to Evaluate Medical AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.12822v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Blinded physician evaluation has been considered by many to be the gold standard for assessing clinical reasoning in large language models (LLMs). This is difficult to scale; thus, prior studies typically rely on small physician panels, often from a single institution or specialty, which both limits the scientific questions investigated and makes it unclear whether findings would be reproduced with a different set of evaluators. To more rigorously and scalably study clinical reasoning in AI models, here we introduce PrecepTron, an LLM fine-tuned for physician-level evaluation of open-ended responses. PrecepTron was trained using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) of a 32-billion-parameter model on a small number of physician examples. We also release GRAND-ROUNDS, a new large-scale physician-annotated benchmark of 9,217 scored responses from 160 clinicians across seven studies. translated_title: 扩展临床判断以评估医疗AI
translated_abstract: 盲法医生评估长期以来被许多人视为评估大语言模型（LLM）临床推理能力的金标准。然而这种方法难以规模化，因此先前的研究通常依赖于小型医生评审小组，且往往来自单一机构或单一专科，这既限制了可研究的科学问题，也使得研究结果能否被不同评审者复现变得不明确。为了更严谨、更可扩展地研究AI模型的临床推理能力，本文提出了PrecepTron——一个经过微调、能够以医生水平评估开放式回答的大语言模型。PrecepTron基于一个320亿参数的模型，采用低秩适应（LoRA）技术，仅使用少量医生示例进行训练。研究者还发布了GRAND-ROUNDS，这是一个全新的大规模医生标注基准数据集，包含来自七项研究中160名临床医生对9,217份回答的评分。研究结果显示，在典型的“LLM作为评判者”（LLM-as-a-judge）方法中，前沿大语言模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出PrecepTron（基于LoRA微调的320亿参数医生级评估模型）和GRAND-ROUNDS（包含160名临床医生对9,217份回答评分的大规模基准），实现了可规模化的临床判断，以更严谨地评估医疗AI的临床推理能力。
en_tdlr: This study introduces PrecepTron, an LLM fine-tuned via LoRA on a 32-billion-parameter model for physician-level evaluation of open-ended responses, and releases GRAND-ROUNDS, a large-scale benchmark of 9,217 physician-scored responses from 160 clinicians, enabling scalable clinical judgment to evaluate medical AI.
